bill.constitutionalAuthorityStatementText:
[Congressional Record Volume 165, Number 88 (Friday, May 24, 2019)]
[House]
From the Congressional Record Online through the Government Publishing Office [www.gpo.gov]
By Ms. WILSON of Florida:
H.R. 3027.
Congress has the power to enact this legislation pursuant
to the following:
Article I, Section 8 of the U.S. Constitution
[Page H4171]

latestAction.text: Referred to the Committee on Education and Labor, and in addition to the Committees on Ways and Means, the Judiciary, and Oversight and Reform, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.

bill.title: Student Loan Borrowers’ Bill of Rights Act of 2019
